maria (pm): Heads-up — customer asks keep coming about partial JSON + function-calling in streaming. We need a clear roadmap item and launch criteria for v1 streaming semantics.
ajay (eng): Agree. Proposing an MVP that focuses on text deltas + minimal finish reasons. Defer structured/stable partial JSON until v2.
sasha (platform): Q: are we mandating transport? SSE only for hosted? WS for Dedicated/Private?
maria (pm): Prefer not to mandate, but we should recommend defaults per deployment mode and call out tradeoffs.
chris (cs): Enterprise customers want resume + deterministic finish reasons for auditing. Mobile customers care more about low-latency incremental updates.
tom (mobile): For mobile SDKs we need a single, resilient fallback: prefer websocket with automatic reconnection + resume token. On flaky networks SSE sometimes drops and proxies mangle chunked events.
ajay (eng): Implementation notes: runtime already emits token deltas and final finish_reason. We can expose finish_reason values: stop, length_limit, cancelled, error. Keep them stable strings.
maria (pm): Action: define MVP semantics + telemetry + SDK behavior. Suggest MVP scope: (1) streaming text deltas, (2) explicit finish_reason enum, (3) a resume token model for short reconnects (best-effort), (4) SDK-level reconnection guidance. No structured partial JSON or function-call chunking for MVP.
sasha (platform): Ops considerations: resume tokens need to be cheap (KV cached by request id) and TTLed. Also need per-route throttling flags to avoid unbounded replays.
ajay (eng): How about a simple resume token: base64(request_id + last_token_index + hmac)? Short-lived (60s). We can keep it best-effort (no strong consistency).
tom (mobile): That works for 60s, but mobile often loses background sockets for longer. If we promise only short reconnects, make sure SDK surfaces status clearly.
maria (pm): Launch criteria proposal for MVP: 1) SDKs (js, python, mobile) implement streaming consumers and expose finish_reason; 2) Telemetry events emitted for start/delta/finish with finish_reason and tokens_streamed; 3) Perf SLO: p50 token latency < 50ms on hosted; 4) Customer acceptance tests: two pilot customers validate behavior.
chris (cs): Add acceptance: deterministic replay for auditing — even if best-effort, we need a post-hoc transcript with finish_reason and final model version.
ajay (eng): We'll also need clear contract about partial JSON: in MVP we treat partial JSON as text. SDKs can optionally buffer and attempt to parse on the client when complete.
sasha (platform): Transport recommendation doc snippet: - Hosted: default SSE with Transfer-Encoding chunking, but offer websocket for low-latency routes. - Dedicated/Private: favour websockets for persistent connections and resume support. - Mobile SDK: websocket primary with HTTP fallback (SSE or long-poll). Note proxies can break websocket on corporate networks, so include fallback.
maria (pm): Decision call: Do we accept this MVP scope? Vote: +1 from product for go, -1 to postpone.
achoy (typo-bot): (no vote)
ajay (eng): +1 — keep scope tight. We can add structured output in v2 with partial-JSON framing.
tom (mobile): +1 if SDK surfaces reconnect states and resume TTLs.
sasha (platform): +1 but need clear ops cost estimate (KV overhead for resume tokens and increased tracing).
maria (pm): OK, consensus to proceed. Next steps: ajay to write API spec PR for streaming messages and finish_reason enum; tom to draft mobile SDK guidance; sasha to list ops/runbook items.
ajay (eng): I'll open PR with example events and minimal schema. Example event below:```
data: {"type":"delta","request_id":"r_123","cursor":45,"text":"..."}
data: {"type":"finish","request_id":"r_123","finish_reason":"stop","model":"redwood-alpha-v1"}
```
chris (cs): Can we include a telemetry dimension for customer-expected-behavior so we can correlate support tickets?
maria (pm): Yes — add tags: customer_id, pilot_flag, route. Must be PII-safe.
sasha (platform): I'll add retention and ACL notes for telemetry. Also document fallback costs.
maria (pm): Timeline: spec PR this week, SDK guidance next week, pilot rollouts in 3 weeks. If blockers hit, flag in #release-war-room.
ajay (eng): Noted. I'll mark the PR as draft and include unit tests for finish_reason mapping.
tom (mobile): I'll prototype reconnect UI signals for iOS/Android and share sample code.
maria (pm): Thanks team. tagging follow-ups: @ajay please cc @sasha on resume token shape. @tom coordinate with @chris for pilot customer mobile testing. :rocket:
